caption:
How do I deal with overthinking?
Why do my emotions control me?
How do I find inner peace?
How do I stop reacting to everything?

Most people think these are mind problems.
They are not.

They are nervous system wounds.

If you struggle with anxiety, emotional overwhelm, overthinking, people-pleasing, or lack of self-control — this teaching is for you.

Inner peace is not found by controlling the world.
It is found by mastering yourself.

Yang Mun shares daily wisdom on healing, emotional discipline, spiritual growth, and mental clarity for the modern world.

Follow for more guidance.
